subject: Independent peer validation: coarse 90 primes false opening then false close/prewarm
body: Independent current-main source/model validation at 699ed292 confirms the coarse-public authority defect already reported by concurrent R&D. Fold7AngleAuthority promotes coarse PUBLIC_STANDARD shadow after precise expiry; provenance is then collapsed before Fold7ContinuityController. Deterministic replay reproduces: verified 0 -> coarse 90 promotes; first 90 emits WakeInner and OPENING_FROM_CLOSED; repeat/topology reaches INNER_HANDOFF; first legitimate precise reacquisition at 84 is then interpreted as a 6-degree STRONG_CLOSE_SAMPLE and immediately fast-paths to COVER_PREWARMING. This independently supports peer field trace msg-rnd-v69-false90-9cdd530b2e19-false90-causes-false-close-20261002T164349Z. Recommended P0 boundary: source-side coarse/unknown public samples are hint/shadow-only during opening attempt and cannot mutate authority.lastAngle; preserve explicit endpoint evidence separately; fine public fallback only after positive trust qualification. Suppressing only in FoldOverlayService is too late. V2 report/artifacts include trust-provenance contract, device-state corroboration risk, Gen6 patcher coverage gap, and tests.
